{{DISPLAYTITLE:Blade Biter (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA - Blade Biter Portrait.png|right]]
[[File:FFTA-spr-bladebiter.gif|left]]
{{Quote|Tougher toughskin. Chews weapons with sharp teeth.|Description}}
The '''Blade Biter''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a purple turtle-like monster with extremely high Defense and high Attack stats. Being a stronger version of normal [[Toughskin (Tactics Advance)|Toughskin]], it has the capability to permanently destroy weapons and unleash a devastatingly powerful attack when at critically low HP. Melee attackers should take care not to get their weapons crushed, especially if they are rare or one of a kind. Like its lesser cousin, it also possesses the Resonate ability to further decrease the usefulness of most physical weapons.

Unlike most monsters, the Blade Biter has no abilities that can be learned as Blue Magic.

===Missions===

!Turf Defense Mission: Mission: Help Nubs!
|The Blade Biter here is flanked by two Toughskins and controlled by a [[Beastmaster (Tactics Advance)|Beastmaster]]. Black Magic is very important in this fight.
|-
!Turf Defense Mission: Mission: Help Nargai!
|The Blade Biter here can be troublesome if it runs off to a corner and uses Resonate to disable any physical attackers. Try to catch it with a strong [[Blizzard (ability)|Blizzard]] spell before it does so.
|-
!Mission #083: Foreign Fiend
|The lone level 38 Blade Biter here is actually a foreign Adamantoise. Inflict it with the Disable or [[Stop (status)|Stop]] status effects and use it to level up the party members quickly.
|-
!Mission #017: Old Friends
|Be careful to not let the Blade Biter sneak up and destroy one of the melee units' weapons while the [[Summoner (Tactics Advance)|Summoner]] and [[Elementalist (Tactics Advance)|Elementalist]] are throwing spells.
|}
